description: This file defines a Fragment named TransfersFragment responsible for displaying real-time transfer statuses and progress in a RecyclerView. It utilizes TransferManager to observe transfer status updates and updates the UI accordingly. It also includes internal classes for the RecyclerView adapter and view holder.

classes.name: TransferAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying TransferStatus items, managing item views and binding data.

classes.name: TransferVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for transfer item views, holding references to UI components.

methods.name: TransfersFragment.newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of TransfersFragment.

methods.name: TransferAdapter.submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: TransferAdapter.onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder with its item view components.

methods.name: TransferAdapter.getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of transfer items.

methods.name: TransferAdapter.onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds transfer data to the view holder for display.
